name: The Crumbling Reaper
description: Primary key. **Duration 600t (30s). Cooldown 24000t.** - Every 60t: lowest-health `#tarot:hostile` **AND enemy player** within 10 blocks dies (bosses 50%/tick cap; enemy players capped 50% HP removed per tick) - +1 Absorption per kill (cap 10) - 15-block unstable ground: any entity standing takes 4 damage/sec - Unstable-kill Absorption applies - Absorption cap 15 hearts, persists 1200t
